Shire of Ravensthorpe Council meetings are held monthly and are open to the public.

Members of the community may: 

  • Attend Council meetings
  • Ask questions during Public Question Time
  • Make a deputation to Council
  • Submit a petition

Participation in meetings is conducted in accordance with the Shire’s adopted Meeting Procedures.

Audio of meetings is published online afterwards.

If you require assistance to attend a meeting or access meeting information in an alternative format, please contact the Shire.
